ID.Description: Unique, fully randomly generated replacement identifier for each participant, as confirmed by the data provider. It is not derived from the original identifying code and is not a cognitive measurement. Random replacement identifiers alone do not establish anonymity of the participant-level data. The original-to-replacement mapping is not included in this data dictionary.

Age at neuropsych test.Description: Age represented by three-year bin midpoints anchored at 18 years: for example, 19.5 represents the 18 to less than 21 years bin. The final upper endpoint was included in the last bin during binning. One age value was reassigned to a neighboring bin for privacy protection; therefore these values must not be interpreted as exact ages or universally accurate age intervals. The analysis uses broader 12-year age bands anchored at 18 for cross-validation balance.

Gender.Description: Gender category recorded in the source dataset. Does it represent self-identified gender or sex assigned at birth?

BDDin Q9 - Antidepressants.Description: Recorded antidepressant status. NA denotes missing status, not a third medication category.

SRT - Total mean reaction latency.LongName: Simple Reaction Time task: mean reaction latency
SRT - Total mean reaction latency.Description: Mean response latency in the Simple Reaction Time (SRT) task, assessing reaction time. Lower latency indicates faster responding. The source header does not specify a time unit; milliseconds are plausible but unverified, so Units is deliberately omitted.

Trail making B - # of sec.LongName: Trail Making Test Part B: completion time
Trail making B - # of sec.Description: Time to complete Trail Making Test (TMT) Part B, assessing executive function and psychomotor speed. Lower times indicate faster completion. The analysis derives a B-minus-A completion-time difference from the two TMT columns.

Trail making A - # of sec.LongName: Trail Making Test Part A: completion time
Trail making A - # of sec.Description: Time to complete Trail Making Test (TMT) Part A, assessing psychomotor speed. Lower times indicate faster completion.

SDMT total score.LongName: Symbol Digit Modalities task: total score
SDMT total score.Description: Total raw score on the Symbol Digit Modalities task (SDMT), used in this study to assess psychomotor speed and working memory. Higher scores indicate better performance. Administration mode and detailed scoring rules are not specified in the available project materials.

Letter-number sequencing total score.LongName: WAIS-IV Letter Number Sequencing: total score
Letter-number sequencing total score.Description: Total raw score on the WAIS-IV Letter Number Sequencing (LNS) task, assessing working memory. Higher scores indicate better performance. This is the source total score, not an age-standardized score.

D-KEFS (STROOP) - Color-word interferenc.LongName: D-KEFS Color-Word Interference: Condition 4 raw score
D-KEFS (STROOP) - Color-word interferenc.Description: Raw score for Condition 4 (inhibition/switching) of the Delis-Kaplan Executive Function System (D-KEFS) Color-Word Interference task, assessing executive function. The analysis treats this column as Stroop completion time. The workbook header does not specify units or the exact raw-score definition; these require confirmation before assigning Units.

RAVLT - correct A1-A5.LongName: Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task: learning trials A1 to A5
RAVLT - correct A1-A5.Description: Number of correctly recalled words summed across learning trials A1 to A5 of the Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task (RAVLT), assessing verbal learning and memory. Higher values indicate greater recall. The analysis adds this value to A6 and A7 and divides by seven. The current workbook contains a value of 434, inconsistent with the conventional five-trial, 15-word sum; that value requires source verification and has not been corrected.

RAVLT - correct A6 (immediate recall).LongName: Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task: A6 immediate recall
RAVLT - correct A6 (immediate recall).Description: Number of correctly recalled words on RAVLT trial A6, labelled immediate recall in the source, assessing verbal memory. Higher values indicate greater recall.

RAVLT - correct A7 (delayed recall).LongName: Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task: A7 delayed recall
RAVLT - correct A7 (delayed recall).Description: Number of correctly recalled words on RAVLT trial A7, labelled delayed recall in the source, assessing verbal memory. Higher values indicate greater recall. The delay duration is not documented in the workbook header.

Proportion of target stimuli expressing happiness correctly identified as that emotion. Stored on a 0 to 1 scale, not as a percentage. The project signal-detection calculation assumes 20 target trials.

Mean intensity threshold - Sad (ascendin.LongName: EMOTICOM Intensity Morphing: sadness ascending threshold
Mean intensity threshold - Sad (ascendin.Description: Mean perceptual detection threshold for sadness in the ascending condition of the EMOTICOM Intensity Morphing Task (IM): facial expression changes from neutral toward sadness; the threshold marks detection of the emerging emotion. This indexes emotion perception thresholds. Values represent the original 1 to 15 intensity-level scale, not percentages. The analysis converts levels to percentages using (value - 1) / 14 * 100 when calculating certain derived biases.

Overall comments.Description: Free-text source comments that include cohort annotations such as KOHORTE 1, KOHORTE 2, and KOHORTE 3, sometimes with additional text. This is not a clean categorical cohort variable. The analysis uses this field to identify the configured holdout/calibration cohort. Detailed comment contents are not reproduced in this dictionary.

DatasetMetadata.Description: BIDS-style column dictionary for the current data.xlsx workbook. Keys match the workbook headers exactly. This sidecar alone does not make the Excel workbook or project a BIDS-compliant dataset.
DatasetMetadata.MissingValueEncoding: The project workbook uses literal NA and/or blank cells for missing values; the R reader treats both as missing. NA is not a categorical level. A strict BIDS TSV export would use n/a for missing/non-applicable values.
DatasetMetadata.DescriptionSources: Exact workbook headers; project src/R/load_and_prepdata.R; task/domain descriptions supplied by the study author; the cited EMOTICOM validation article.
